reels.title: M26 VELOSIPED
reels.caption:
Same road. Two choices. 🚲

Day 1, one takes the bike, one sits in traffic. Day 30, rain and a flat tire. Next morning, he rides again. A year later: 2,920 km. The other? 274 hours in traffic.

Small choices, every day.

Send this to someone stuck in traffic.

#cycling #habits #discipline #motivation #selfimprovement

reels.title: M27 GEZINTI
reels.caption:
Same evening. 20 free minutes. 🚶

One goes for a walk. One picks the sofa. Day 30, too tired, he skips. Next evening, he walks again. A year later: 730 km. The other: 121 hours on the sofa.

Same 20 minutes. Different year.

Send this to your sofa friend.

#walking #habits #health #motivation #selfimprovement
